FAQ.section_description: Everything you need to know about the current Alpha test, free accounts, and future licensing tiers.
FAQ.q1: What does the current free Alpha Tester tier include?
FAQ.a1: During the evaluation phase with friends and testers, all accounts and organizations receive the Alpha Tester tier with 100% unrestricted access to the Omnibar, Google sync, and project cells at no cost.
FAQ.q2: How does the free tier and the 30-day trial for collaborators work?
FAQ.a2: Creating an account and your first organization is completely free forever for 1 user. When inviting the first guest to your team, a 30-day free trial is activated. Beyond that trial, additional team seats require a subscription.
FAQ.q3: What is the difference between Google Sync read-only and edit mode?
FAQ.a3: Read-only access (viewing your calendar events and tasks in the feed) is included for free. Two-way editing and event creation from the Omnibar is part of the Professional tier.
FAQ.q4: How are external connectors like STEL Order ERP integrated?
FAQ.a4: Connectors to third-party billing and ERP systems are managed as independent monthly add-ons, allowing you to pay only for the integrations you need.
FAQ.q5: What happens if an organization becomes inactive (zombie accounts)?
FAQ.a5: To protect infrastructure and comply with GDPR, organizations inactive for over 60 days become dormant; at 90 days external tokens are revoked, and after 180 days they are scheduled for deletion. Alpha tester accounts are protected from deletion.
FAQ.q6: Can I manage multiple organizations with one account?
FAQ.a6: Yes, you can be a member of multiple organizations. However, a single user can only own 1 free organization at a time; owning more requires a paid plan.

Instructions.section_description: Capture ideas in milliseconds with natural language and organize projects effortlessly.
Instructions.step1_desc: Write your thoughts freely. Prefix with '// ' to register an actionable task, or capture quick ideas and notes.
Instructions.step2_desc: Use '@' to assign team members and '#' to link to project cells (#marketing, #launch).
Instructions.step3_desc: Type deadlines like 'tomorrow at 10', 'next Friday', or 'in 3 days'. The engine schedules the particle automatically.
Instructions.tip1_desc: On phones and tablets, tap the floating '+' button in the bottom corner to type with your thumb on the go.
Instructions.tip2_desc: Press ⌘K (Mac) or Ctrl+K (Windows) from any view to trigger the Omnibar instantly.
Instructions.tip3_desc: Click any '#' tag to filter your board by project and view its completion rate in real time.
